data.title: AHF Champions Girls’ Health, Rights and Futures on International Day of the Girl
data.description: In Los Angeles, on the occasion of the International Day of the Girl (celebrated on Oct. 11 annually), the AIDS Healthcare Foundation (AHF) is urging for increased efforts to provide girls worldwide with necessary resources for health, education, protection, and opportunities to succeed. Despite advancements over the years, significant obstacles still hinder girls' progress. HIV disproportionately impacts girls in various regions globally, with girls representing over two-thirds of new infections in 2025.

data.title: TestMu AI Positioned as a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Agentic Software Quality Assurance Platforms
data.description: In NOIDA, India, on October 9, 2026, TestMu AI revealed that it has achieved a prominent status as a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Agentic Software Quality. The company's Full-Stack Agentic AI Quality Engineering platform has been recognized for its strong performance in both Completeness of Vision and Ability to Execute. This evaluation highlights TestMu AI's profound expertise and capabilities in this field. This acknowledgment from Gartner® underscores TestMu AI's leadership position within the competitive landscape of Agentic Software Quality.
